Section Purpose & Guidance: First impression of Niche Global. Establish that the brand helps people explore realistic pathways to build a career and potentially a life internationally. Focus on the destination and career outcome, not the mechanism used to get there.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Headline is fixed: “Life Beyond Borders.” Supporting copy should be only 1–2 short lines. Communicate that Niche Global helps identify suitable international career pathways based on profile, education, experience, skills, career goals and ambitions. Do not explain visas, programs, fees or processes. Career/life outcome first; pathway second.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: USA-led opening visual, preferably San Francisco / Silicon Valley / Bay Area. Premium, wide international career/lifestyle image with subtle blur/dark treatment. Avoid graduation caps, campuses, passports, visa stamps, airplanes, suitcases, excessive flags and typical overseas-education imagery.
CTA Guidance: Primary CTA: Find My Pathway / Discover My Pathway / Explore My Options. Final wording to be recommended by content writer.

Component / Row: Hero Scroll 2 — Your Profile Comes First
Section Purpose & Guidance: Communicate that Niche Global begins with the individual rather than starting with a country, course, visa or predefined program.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Create a short headline and maximum 1–2 lines around understanding the person’s education, experience, skills, profile and ambitions first. Keep it personalized and confident.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Use the real Niche Global/Niche office in Kochi. Prefer an authentic consultation/discussion between team and candidate. Enhance lighting/cleanliness if needed while keeping the office recognizable.
CTA Guidance: Contextual CTA optional. Do not force a CTA if it disrupts the hero flow.

Component / Row: Hero Scroll 3 — Different People, Different Pathways
Section Purpose & Guidance: Show that there is no single route to an international career. The appropriate route depends on the individual profile and destination.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Short headline + maximum 1–2 lines. Communicate the concept of multiple possible pathways without turning the hero into a visa/program list or implying universal eligibility.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Sophisticated multiple-pathway/global-opportunity visual or authentic consultation imagery. Avoid cliché forked-road graphics and generic visa imagery.
CTA Guidance: Contextual CTA optional; primary website CTA remains Find My Pathway.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Establish a key Niche Global philosophy: simply going abroad is not the success metric. The pathway should make sense for employability, international experience, earning potential and longer-term career direction.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Short headline + maximum 1–2 lines. Focus on outcome and career progression. Avoid guarantees or promises of jobs, visas, settlement or income.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Authentic international workplace/career imagery; preferably real candidate/program outcome imagery as the asset library grows.
CTA Guidance: Contextual CTA optional. Keep the hero uncluttered.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Establish who Niche Global is, where it comes from and why it exists. Define Niche Global on its own terms rather than comparing it with overseas education consultancies, recruitment agencies or visa companies.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Communicate: profile-first approach; person → career → destination → pathway; U.S. roots, Kochi presence, Kerala focus; origin from Niche Techies’ U.S. technology talent/staff-augmentation background. Keep to section label + headline + approx. 60–80 words + optional credibility statement. Do not explain what Niche Global is 'not'.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Use real Kochi office/team imagery, ideally an authentic consultation or discussion. Real first, AI enhanced, never generic. Office should remain recognizable.
CTA Guidance: Exploration CTA: Our Story / Learn More About Niche Global, if a dedicated About page exists. Otherwise no CTA.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Explain how Niche Global thinks before introducing individual programs. Turn the brand promise into a simple methodology.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Guide content around: Understand Your Profile → Define Career Direction → Identify Markets → Evaluate Pathways → Recommend Next Steps. Exact number/names can be refined. Section should answer “What happens when I come to Niche Global?” without visa, fee, university or program detail. Use section label + headline + short intro + one short line per step.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean process visualization/cards/timeline rather than another large photo. Could visually resemble a profile-matching process without looking overly technical or AI-heavy.
CTA Guidance: Start My Profile Evaluation / Find My Pathway. CTA should lead toward the profile evaluation experience.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Introduce USA as one of a deliberately selected set of international career markets. Country is a career market, not a travel/study destination.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Country name + short headline + 1–2 line career-oriented statement + 2–3 relevant career/pathway areas if appropriate + Explore USA CTA. Direction: technology, professional careers, employer ecosystem and multiple profile-dependent pathways. Do not explain visas/fees/program details here.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: One-country-at-a-time full-width carousel. San Francisco / Silicon Valley / modern professional environment. Premium, consistent treatment across all destination slides.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Present UK as a selected career market with specific relevance to the profiles/pathways Niche Global serves.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Country name + short headline + 1–2 lines + 2–3 relevant areas if appropriate. Direction: healthcare and other identified professional career opportunities. Avoid generic 'dream destination' language.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: London or recognizable modern professional environment; avoid overly tourist-heavy Big Ben/red-bus treatment.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Present Australia as a selected career market based on relevant professional/skilled pathways.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Country name + short headline + 1–2 lines + 2–3 relevant areas. Direction: healthcare and selected skilled/professional career opportunities. Eligibility depends on profile.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Sydney/Melbourne modern career/lifestyle imagery rather than beach/tourism imagery.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Present France as a selected market with specific career-pathway relevance.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Country name + short headline + 1–2 lines + 2–3 relevant areas. Direction: hospitality, culinary and international hotel career pathways. Keep homepage high-level.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Premium France imagery connected to the sectors actually served, especially hospitality; not necessarily generic Paris tourism.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Present South Korea as a selected market for specialized career/training opportunities.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Country name + short headline + 1–2 lines + 2–3 relevant areas. Direction: selected specialized career, training and industry-specific pathways. Avoid overclaiming.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Modern Seoul/contemporary professional environment. Avoid making the visual entirely K-pop/entertainment focused.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Introduce types of legitimate international career pathways without becoming a visa catalogue. Country = where; pathway = how.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Create consumer-friendly pathway name + one concise description focused on what the pathway is designed to accomplish. Employment/employer sponsorship may form part of the route where legally and factually applicable. Do not imply availability to everyone.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean pathway card/tile with simple visual/icon. Consistent with other pathway cards.
CTA Guidance: Explore Pathways / Learn More, only if a destination page exists.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Show education as one possible strategic pathway toward a career outcome, not the defining Niche Global category.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Consumer-friendly name + one concise description. Education can be used strategically where it creates access to relevant international experience/post-study career possibilities. Avoid guarantees.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean pathway card/tile.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Introduce structured international internship experience as one possible pathway.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Consumer-friendly name + concise description around building international experience/profile and possible subsequent career opportunities. Do not promise conversion to employment.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean pathway card/tile.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Introduce international training, professional development and eligible exchange routes.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Consumer-friendly name + concise description. Keep technical visa terminology out of homepage copy unless necessary.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean pathway card/tile.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Allow for profile-specific routes for experienced, skilled or otherwise qualifying professionals.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Consumer-friendly name + concise description. Reinforce that eligibility and appropriate route depend on individual profile, destination and applicable requirements.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean pathway card/tile.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Answer why a visitor should trust Niche Global with an important international career decision. Build credibility through how the company operates, where it comes from and how recommendations are made.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Build around approx. five reasons: U.S. Roots/Kerala Focus; Profile Before Pathway; Career Outcome in Mind; Selected Markets, Not Everything Everywhere; International Ecosystem where factually supportable. Use section label + headline + 2–3 line intro + 4–6 short reason statements. Avoid No.1, best, guaranteed job/visa, 100% success or unsupported claims.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Strongly authentic. Use real Kochi office, team, candidate consultations, partner meetings and international program/interaction imagery. Could use clean 3–5 image collage. AI may enhance genuine assets but should not invent the reality.
CTA Guidance: High-intent conversation CTA. Direction: Talk to Us / Meet Our Team / Talk to a Career Advisor. Final terminology to be legally/brand validated.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Show that Niche Global operates through a growing international ecosystem of institutions, training organizations, employers, hotel groups, industry partners and strategic relationships where applicable.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Section label + headline + approx. 2 lines. Use precise relationship terminology: Partner / Institution / Training Provider / Employer Network / Hotel Network / Strategic Relationship. Do not call every organization a partner without verification or permission.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Logo-led, clean and premium. Horizontal logo carousel, potentially grouped by country. Use only verified logos/relationships and confirm public display permission. Optional authentic partner/program image.
CTA Guidance: No CTA by default. Explore Our Network only if a dedicated network page is created.
Content Owner / Assignee: Create verified partner/network master list including organization, country, relationship type, relevant pathway, logo permission, website and public-display status.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Humanize the proposition through authentic candidate journeys. Show starting point → pathway → destination → outcome. Candidate is the hero, not Niche Global.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: For each story: candidate name; starting profile; country/pathway; 2–4 line journey summary; current outcome where verifiable; optional short quote. Avoid generic praise/testimonials. Exact story must be real and documented.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Real candidate photos/videos only. Prioritize departure, training, internship/workplace and destination assets. No AI-generated people. One featured journey at a time in horizontal scroll.
Content Owner / Assignee: Build candidate story asset library: before profile, pathway, country, photos, videos, current status, outcome, testimonial, publication permission.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Second authentic journey; prioritize diversity of profile/country/pathway.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Same content structure as 08A. Select a genuinely strong, documented story.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Same authentic visual standard as 08A.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Third authentic journey. Three strong stories are the minimum recommended for launch.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Same content structure as 08A. Do not create filler stories simply to reach the target.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Same authentic visual standard as 08A.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Additional featured journey toward target of six.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Same content structure; prioritize diversity of country/career area/pathway.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Same authentic visual standard.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Additional featured journey toward target of six.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Same content structure; prioritize diversity.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Same authentic visual standard.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Sixth featured journey. Homepage target is six; launch minimum is three strong stories.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Same content structure; prioritize diversity.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Same authentic visual standard.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Turn the Profile First philosophy into an interactive experience. Help visitors explore what may fit without requiring them to understand countries, visas or programs first.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Provide section headline + very short introduction. Message should invite the visitor to tell Niche Global where they are today. Avoid promising automated eligibility.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Conversational, mobile-first interactive UI. One simple question at a time. Tap whenever possible; type only when necessary.
CTA Guidance: Primary: Check My Profile. Secondary/escape path: Talk to Us.
Content Owner / Assignee: If development threatens launch timing, Phase 1 fallback is profile cards + simple evaluation/contact form.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Capture qualification with minimal friction.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Create clear question wording and predefined answers: Plus Two / Diploma / Bachelor's / Master's / Other. Other can open free-text input.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Large tap-friendly answer buttons/cards; no keyboard unless Other is selected.
CTA Guidance: Continue automatically after selection; persistent subtle Talk to Us option.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Understand where the visitor is in the career journey.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Question + predefined answers such as Student / Fresher / 1–3 Years / 3–7 Years / 7+ Years / Other.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Tap-first conversational interface.
CTA Guidance: Continue; allow Not Sure/Other where useful.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Capture broad career/industry area for routing and qualification.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Question + predefined answers such as Technology / Healthcare / Hospitality / Business / Engineering / Finance / Other. Categories can be refined based on actual offerings.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Tap-first category cards; Other opens free text.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Understand what the visitor is trying to achieve rather than assuming the solution.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Question + answers such as Work Abroad / Build an International Career / International Experience / Career Change / Not Sure Yet. Final language to be refined by content writer.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Simple tap options.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Capture destination preference without forcing the visitor to choose a solution.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: USA / UK / Australia / France / South Korea / I'm Open. 'I'm Open' is important and should be clearly visible.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Country options as clean cards/buttons; avoid making this look like a country catalogue.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Collect contact details after the visitor has invested in the matcher, rather than at the beginning.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Provide wording around having a better picture of the profile and inviting the visitor to continue. Fields: Name, WhatsApp/Phone, Email. Include privacy/consent language.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean, short form at the end of the interactive sequence.
CTA Guidance: Get My Profile Evaluated / equivalent. Also retain Talk to Us path.

Status / Phase: Locked / Phase 1 Target; Full logic may be Phase 2
Section Purpose & Guidance: Give useful direction without making automated eligibility promises.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Use careful language such as 'Your profile may be worth exploring for…' or 'Potential areas to evaluate.' Never 'Congratulations, you qualify.' Results can show markets/pathways as Worth Exploring / Potential Match / Requires Further Evaluation. Human review should remain central.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Personalized result cards/summary. Keep transparent that this is preliminary and subject to evaluation.
CTA Guidance: Get My Profile Evaluated / Talk to Our Team
Content Owner / Assignee: Phase 2 can add full matching logic, CRM integration, lead scoring and saved profiles.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Explain what happens after someone engages with Niche Global. Distinct from Section 03: this is the customer journey, not the pathway-selection methodology.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Guide around: Profile Evaluation → Opportunity & Pathway Discussion → Pathway Selection → Preparation & Processing → International Transition → Career Progression. Validate exact operational steps. Use section label + headline + 1–2 line intro + step name + one short explanation each. Avoid operational checklists/payment details.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Clean horizontal timeline on desktop and vertical timeline on mobile. Process should be the visual hero. Real candidate imagery can appear subtly but should not distract.
CTA Guidance: Start With My Profile / Start My Evaluation. Can link back to Section 09 matcher.
Content Owner / Assignee: Validate the actual operational process before final copy.

Section Purpose & Guidance: Reserved for genuine visitor concerns once the rest of the website and business positioning are clearer.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Do not draft generic FAQs yet. Build questions later from real candidate concerns, sales conversations, legal/compliance needs and website user behavior.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Placeholder only. Final visual format to be decided after FAQ scope is defined.

Component / Row: Get in Touch / Start Your Journey
Section Purpose & Guidance: Provide a conventional, low-friction lead-capture path for visitors who do not want to use the interactive profile matcher. Complement, not replace, the matcher and WhatsApp/talk option.
Core Messaging / Content Writer Instruct: Provide headline + 1–2 line supporting message + field labels + placeholder text where needed + CTA + submission confirmation + consent/privacy language. Suggested fields: Full Name*, Phone/WhatsApp*, Email, Current Qualification*, Current Career Status*, Interested Country (USA/UK/Australia/France/South Korea/Not Sure Yet), optional Message. Do not collect detailed age/passport/marks/salary/budget data here.
Visual Guidance / Designer Instructions: Two-column layout: left = authentic Kochi office/candidate consultation image and short message; right = clean static form. Mobile stacks content then form. Keep visually simple and conversion-focused.
CTA Guidance: Static form CTA direction: Request a Callback / Talk to Niche Global / Submit — final wording by content writer. Keep WhatsApp/talk option available as lowest-friction path.
